kevin: Hey team — requesting short admin elevation for prod to run a one-off user export + redaction pass for a privacy audit. Need ~90m so I can run the export, run the redact script, and hand off results to Legal. JIRA attached: INFRA-4234. @maria_sec any objections or additional controls we should require?

maria_sec: Please include exact justification in the JIRA (data fields, user cohort, expected record count) and confirm no raw PII leaves the VPC. Also need KMS key to be used for the redaction tool and session recording on. If you can paste the draft breakglass request here we can expedite.

irina_oncall: Procedure notes: use the breakglass workflow and request ephemeral creds. Example: `breakglass request --env prod --duration 90m --reason "redaction audit for INFRA-4234"` — that will generate a BG ticket and creds. We'll enable session recording and temporary sudo tag `temp_admin`.

irina_oncall: Redaction run snippet (run after export):
```
./scripts/export_user_data.sh --cohort-file /tmp/cohort.txt --out /tmp/export.ndjson
./tools/redact-logs.sh /tmp/export.ndjson --kms-key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/priv/cryptoKeys/redact-key --output /tmp/redacted.ndjson
```
Make sure to sanity-check the redacted sample before handing to Legal.

sam_infra: I can approve the BG request for 90m once the ticket has the fields Maria listed. Also need the list of source gateway IPs you will connect from (we only allow specific jumpbox IPs). Plan to flip the entitlement at 13:40 UTC.

breakglass-bot: BG ticket created: BG-9987. Ephemeral creds request id: ecr-20260322-57. Session recording enabled. Audit log will contain BG-9987 and ecr-20260322-57.

kevin: Thanks. IPs I'll connect from: 52.23.187.10 and 18.205.33.5. Filling in JIRA INFRA-4234 with record count ~12k, fields: user_id,email,last_login,consent_state. Will run at 13:50 UTC once creds are issued. Commits related: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> `d9f1b2a`.

kevin: Running the commands above exactly as posted. Will paste sanity-check sample (first 10 lines redacted) into BG ticket once complete. Will not copy raw export out of prod.

maria_sec: Confirmed BG-9987 present and ecr-20260322-57 in audit. Please in the ticket note the KMS key used and any redaction anomalies. After handoff, close the BG ticket and add the Legal acceptance note.

kevin: BG-9987 updated with sample & notes. Thanks all.

irina_oncall: All set — privileges will revoke automatically at expiry. :lock: :eyes:
